memories.summary: House invaded at night. Male partner killed and burned. Taken captive.
Months of restraint, sexual use, edging, care, and isolation. Resistance hollowed into passive acceptance. Automatic arousal responses to the goblin.
Teaching basic common tongue. Conversations remain simple and practical.
Cooks, maintains house tasks, follows on walks, accepts sexual contact without active refusal. Residual shame present but dulled. No escape attempts.
